page.overview:
Who is Anchisaurus?

is an extinct genus of prosauropod sauropodomorph dinosaur that lived in Connecticut during the Early Jurassic period. A small slender quadrupedal herbivore, it could have reared up on its hind legs in some circumstances.

Anchisaurus doesn't appear in the movies or the novels.

Anchisaurus is mentioned in the bad end credits to the SEGA Game Gear and Master System versions of Jurassic Park, listed as Anchisaur in Special Thanks (replacing Hase) alongside Quetzalcoatlus, Hererrasaur, Gallimimus, and Ornitholestes.

Anchisaurus can be created in Jurassic Park III: Park Builder.
